sources.title: BurnyCoder/rl-locomotion-steering-vectors · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Download and apply the vector Research record Steering vectors for RL locomotion This repository publishes activation vectors, controls, numerical episodes, and reports from the research code. A fixed vector is added to a frozen RL actor's first ReLU output. No behavioral cloning, imitation training, or new policy training was performed.
